violation_type.title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area - Plan if Licensed Prior to Sept.1, 2003 (26 TAC §746.4403(b))
violation_type.short_title: Handwashing Sink in Diaper-Changing Area - Plan if Licensed Prior to Sept.1, 2003
violation_type.typical_finding: The toddler classroom does not have a handwashing sink in the diaper changing area. The operation will bring this standard into compliance by placing a portable sink by the diaper changing station.

finding_variants.text: The toddler classroom does not have a handwashing sink in the diaper changing area. The operation will bring this standard into compliance by placing a portable sink by the diaper changing station.

A sink in the toddler room used in the diaper changing area was not in working condition.    Note: This was corrected at the inspection when water was added to the sink to make it usable for hand washing after diaper changing.
